steps.title: Analyze 'C' Button Functionality
steps.description: Examined `activity_main.xml` to locate the 'C' button (`R.id.button_clear`) and `MainActivity.java` to understand its associated `onClearClick()` method's current behavior.

steps.title: Modify Layout: Change 'C' Button Text to 'DEL'
steps.description: Updated `activity_main.xml` by changing the `android:text` attribute of the button with `id="@id/button_clear"` from 'C' to 'DEL'.

steps.title: Refactor `onClearClick()` to `onDeleteClick()`
steps.description: Renamed the `private void onClearClick()` method in `MainActivity.java` to `private void onDeleteClick()` to better reflect its new character deletion purpose.

steps.title: Implement Single Character Deletion Logic
steps.description: Added logic to `onDeleteClick()` that, when `currentInput` is not empty, removes the last character from `currentInput`.

steps.title: Handle Empty `currentInput` after Deletion
steps.description: Modified `onDeleteClick()` to ensure that if `currentInput` becomes empty after deletion and the calculator is in a 'new calculation' state, `currentInput` is set to '0' to prevent a blank display.

steps.title: Implement Full Reset (Excluding History) for Empty Input
steps.description: Added logic to `onDeleteClick()` to handle scenarios where `currentInput` is already empty (i.e., a result is displayed). In this case, the method now resets `result`, `currentOperator`, `newCalculation`, `operatorPressed`, and `currentInput` to '0' to prepare for a fresh calculation without affecting the history.

steps.title: Remove History Clearing from Delete Logic
steps.description: Ensured that the `historyList.clear()` call, previously present in `onClearClick()`, is removed from the new `onDeleteClick()` method, preserving the calculation history during 'DEL' operations.

steps.title: Update Button Click Listener
steps.description: Modified the `OnClickListener` for `R.id.button_clear` in `MainActivity.java`'s `onCreate()` method to call the newly implemented `onDeleteClick()` instead of the old `onClearClick()`.

steps.title: Verify Display Updates Post-Deletion
steps.description: Confirmed that `updateDisplay()` is correctly invoked at the end of `onDeleteClick()` to ensure the UI reflects the current state of `currentInput` or `result` after deletion.

steps.title: Test Single Character Deletion
steps.description: Performed testing to ensure that pressing the 'DEL' button accurately removes the last character from the current input.

steps.title: Test Full Reset from Result Display
steps.description: Verified that pressing 'DEL' when a calculation result is displayed correctly resets the calculator to an initial '0' state, ready for new input, without affecting history.

steps.title: Test Interaction with Operators and Equals
steps.description: Conducted tests to confirm that the 'DEL' button functions correctly when used in conjunction with operator inputs and after an equals operation.

steps.title: Test History Persistence
steps.description: Confirmed that the calculation history list remains intact and is not cleared by the new 'DEL' button functionality.

steps.title: Perform Final App Functionality Review
steps.description: Conducted a comprehensive review of all calculator features, including numbers, operators, decimal point, and the history activity, to ensure continued correct operation after the 'DEL' button modification.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Executing build chain suite to compile, link, and package the application artifacts with the updated 'DEL' button functionality.
